exhibits.title: Spot Price
exhibits.statement: Solana (SOL) traded at $90.5400 as of 2026-11-06 12:08:54 UTC, +0.32% over one hour and -5.86% over twenty-four hours.

exhibits.title: 24-Hour Trading Range
exhibits.statement: Over twenty-four hours the price ranged from $88.3500 to $95.5200; spot sits at 31% of that range.

exhibits.title: Seven-Day Trend
exhibits.statement: Price is -7.06% over seven days. The 24-hour average ($90.3564) is below the 72-hour average ($92.9512). Spot is 6.45% below the seven-day high of $96.7814 and 2.48% above the seven-day low of $88.3500.

exhibits.title: Volatility & Momentum
exhibits.statement: Realized volatility computed from hourly closes is 2.94% per day. The 14-hour relative strength index reads 58.5, conventionally neutral.

exhibits.title: Liquidity
exhibits.statement: Twenty-four-hour trading volume was $3.74 billion, equal to 7.00% of the $53.44 billion market capitalization.

exhibits.title: Market Sentiment
exhibits.statement: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 28 ("Fear"), versus 30 7 days earlier.

exhibits.title: Chainlink Price Feed
exhibits.statement: The Chainlink SOL/USD Data Feed on Ethereum mainnet last reported $89.2041, 18.4 hours before the spot quote and -1.48% against the spot price in Exhibit A. Practice positions are entered and settled at this mark.

arguments.text:
May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price of SOL is trading at $90.5400, only 0.32% above its one‑hour mark and well within the 24‑hour range, indicating a stable micro‑trend that favors a long entry at current levels [Ex. A, B].  

2. Realized volatility is modest at 2.94% per day, and the 14‑hour RSI sits at a neutral 58.5, suggesting that upward momentum can be captured without excessive risk of reversal [Ex. D].  

3. Liquidity remains robust with $3.74 billion traded in the past day, equal to 7.0% of market cap, and the Fear index is low at 28, reflecting buying interest that should support price appreciation, while the Chainlink feed price of $89.2041 provides a conservative settlement benchmark for the practice position [Ex. E, F, G].  

The Bull rests.

May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price of SOL is trading at $90.54, merely 31 % up the 24‑hour range and 6.45 % below the seven‑day high, indicating a lack of upward momentum and a price ceiling that is vulnerable to a short‑term pullback; see Exhibits A, B, C.  

2. Realized volatility of 2.94 % per day combined with a neutral RSI of 58.5 suggests the market has sufficient price swing to capture profit on a short without excessive risk of sudden reversal; see Exhibit D.  

3. Market sentiment is entrenched in fear (CF&G Index 28) and the authoritative Chainlink price feed lags the spot by 1.48 %, providing a defensible execution benchmark that further cushions the Bear’s exposure; see Exhibits F, G.  

The Bear rests.

Your Honor, the Bear’s first point collapses under Exhibit B: a 31 % placement in the 24‑hour range is merely the lower third, not a “price ceiling”—the range’s upper bound sits at $95.52, leaving ample upside. Exhibit C shows the 24‑hour average ($90.36) is already below the 72‑hour average ($92.95), evidencing a short‑term downtrend, not a stable pullback target. The Bear’s second point misstates volatility; Exhibit D’s 2.94 % daily realized volatility is modest for crypto, insufficient to justify a short‑term profit‑capture strategy and, coupled with a neutral RSI of 58.5, indicates no overbought condition. Nothing further.

Your Honor, the Bull’s claim of “stable micro‑trend” is undermined by the seven‑day decline of 7.06% and a 24‑hour average ($90.3564) that sits below the 72‑hour average ($92.9512), showing weakening momentum despite the one‑hour uptick [Ex. C]. Moreover, the “neutral” RSI of 58.5 does not signal bullish strength; it merely sits within a wide neutral band and, coupled with the price now 6.45% below the seven‑day high, indicates limited upside potential [Ex. D, C]. Hence the evidence points to a faltering market, not a compelling long case. Nothing further.

ruling.holding: The Court finds that the evidence supports a short practice position on SOL/USD.

findings.finding: Spot price is down 5.86% over 24h and 7.06% over 7 days, indicating bearish pressure
Current price sits at 31% of the 24‑hour range, near the lower third, limiting upside
24‑hour average is below the 72‑hour average, showing short‑term downtrend
Fear & Greed Index at 28 (Fear) signals negative sentiment

ruling.opinion: The exhibits show SOL/USD in a broader decline (Ex. A, C) and positioned near the lower bound of its daily range (Ex. B), limiting bullish upside. Modest volatility and a neutral RSI (Ex. D) do not provide a bullish catalyst, while fear‑dominant sentiment (Ex. F) reinforces downside risk. The lagging Chainlink feed (Ex. G) offers a conservative settlement point for a short. Accordingly, the Court orders a short practice position.
ruling.dissent: The Bull could argue that the modest volatility and neutral RSI allow a controlled long, but the prevailing weekly decline and fear sentiment outweigh that view.
